meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,当你说出触发词,Claude 会只读分析当前仓库所有打开的 issue 和 PR,并为每个项目生成带 GitHub 证据链接的报告,存到 /tmp 下按时间命名的文件夹。它在 GitHub 上不会做任何评论、合并、关闭或加标签等操作。
howto.when: 当你说出 “triage”“triage issues”“triage PRs” 等指令,或要求对仓库的 issue/PR 做分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我对这个仓库做一次 triage
say.note: 会分析所有打开的 issue 和 PR 并生成报告。
会逐个 issue 写分析报告。
会生成 PR 审查报告,不修改 GitHub。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude read-only analyzes all open issues and PRs, writes an evidence-backed report for each to /tmp/{datetime}/, and never takes any GitHub action (no comments/merges/closes/labels).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or ask to analyze repository issues/PRs.

say_en.text: Do a triage on this repository
say_en.note: It will analyze all open issues and PRs and write reports.
It will analyze each open issue and write a report.
It will write PR review reports without modifying GitHub.
